Configuration parameters for constructing a policies instance.

## Signature

```typescript
export interface PoliciesConstructorParameters
```

## Remarks

This interface defines the required configuration for creating an instance of [Policies](/xpm-lib-ts/docs/api/xpm-lib/classes/policies)<!-- -->. Both properties are mandatory.

The parameters provide the minimum <b>xpm</b> version for policy evaluation and the logger for diagnostic output.
